residency.title: Tax residency
residency.intro: Resident for PIT: 183 days in Vietnam within the calendar year or 12 consecutive months, or a permanent residence / lease of 183+ days. Changes go through approval.

statuses.title: Special statuses
statuses.intro: Pregnancy and a child under 12 months protect against employer-initiated termination. Minor / elderly worker are derived from the date of birth.
statuses.employmentRequired: A hazardous-job override needs the employment.
statuses.overrideRequired: A hazardous-job override needs a reason.
statuses.consentHint: Political membership is recorded only with the person's consent.

proposals.title: Tax residency proposals
proposals.intro: Residency status changes proposed by Payroll from days in Vietnam; approve to apply, reject with a reason.
proposals.approveConfirm: Apply this tax residency to the person?
proposals.empty: No proposal is waiting for review.

errors.invalid-tax-residency-basis: The basis does not match the residency status.
